rows.question: What 2024 net income did Bank of America originally report, what does its 2025 annual report now show for 2024, and why the difference?
rows.answer: Bank of America originally reported 2024 net income of $27,132 million in its 2024 annual report. Its 2025 annual report shows 2024 net income of $26,973 million. The difference of $159 million is due to retrospective revisions reflecting accounting method changes, such as reclassifications between income statement line items that net income tax credits and benefits against investment expense.
rows.gold: Originally $27,132 million; the 2025 10-K shows $26,973 million, $159 million lower, because BofA changed its accounting for tax-related equity investments (proportional amortization) and applied it retrospectively.
